kind: drawing and painting app (iOS, Android, desktop)
why: the owner's first named target (2026-10-13); drawing is a skill Void has none of yet, and every card, figure and miniature Void makes gets better once it can draw
rule: Elevenessee: the target's feature is the floor, not the blueprint. Void never ships its copy of X; it ships X plus one notch, and the plus one is written down before the build starts.

features.theirs: thousands of brushes with thickness, opacity and angle controls and a live preview
features.plus_one: describe a brush in words ("dry charcoal that catches the paper grain") and Void makes it, then keeps it as yours
features.progress: 2026-10-13: the Draw card (skills/draw.js): a brush made from words (10 tools, 12 ways to say how it feels), kept in your browser, paper grain that stays put. Still short of theirs: pen pressure and tilt, brush angle, a live preview of the dab, and their sheer number of ready-made brushes.

features.theirs: stroke stabilizer that smooths a shaky line
features.plus_one: smoothing that learns your hand: it measures your own tremor over the first strokes and corrects just that much
features.progress: 2026-10-13: the Draw card measures each stroke's shake (tremorOf), keeps the hand's running tremor in the browser and follows the pen just enough to take it out; a steadiness slider sets it by hand like their levels, and 0 goes back to learning. The browser suite draws the same shaky scribble with it off and on and checks the ink spreads less with it on.

features.theirs: layers without a set limit, clipping masks, 27 blend modes
features.plus_one: layers you can talk to: "put the moon behind the house", "make the shadows softer" moves and edits the right layer
any n-fold symmetry and a perspective grid you set by dragging two lines in a photo you dropped in
filters by name in plain words, previewed side by side, each one undoable by asking

features.theirs: records the drawing process as a video; watch other people's process videos
features.plus_one: the process is kept as strokes, not video: replay it at any speed, scrub it, and branch a new picture from any moment in it
every stroke stays editable as a curve by default, and the picture exports as SVG for free

features.theirs: PNG, PSD and CMYK export (CMYK premium)
features.plus_one: export straight onto the stage: what you draw becomes a card, a sticker or a 3D figure's texture
